title: MUD The Clay Studio

services.name: Session
services.desc: Our MUD 101 signature pottery class, build confidence on the pottery wheel or hand building off the wheel in our signature 6 to 8-week course (depending on the session and holidays), with one 3-hour class each week. Whether you're brand new to clay or returning to build on previous experience, MUD givesyou the time, guidance, and practice to develop your skills at your own pace. You'll learn the fundamentals of wheel throwing, including wedging, centering, opening, pulling walls, trimming, and glazing, hand building with coils, slabs or pinching, while exploring forms and surface decorating techniques that are meaningful to you. With small class sizes and plenty of individual instruction,
